rules: Uptrend (close > SMA50 > SMA200, SMA200 rising over 20 days). Level = old swing (zigzag 6% on closes, last 3 years) that price moved 8%+ above. 'Touched' = first return since: low within 3% of the level, close at or above it (last 5 sessions). 'Near' = close 0-5% above a level not yet revisited. Stop = level - 1 ATR(14). Square of 9: odd squares (1, 9, 25, 49, 81, 121 ...); 'on Sq9' = the level is within 1% of an odd square.
backtest: 2008-26, 3R target vs a stop 1 ATR below the level: breakout retests +0.13R (3,359) vs +0.15R for a random uptrend stock; old swing lows +0.02R vs +0.10R. Worse than random - watch only.
